facts.fact: The Gemini API is a Google AI offering documented at https://aistudio.google.com/docs (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)

Gemini API docs URLs https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/* now return HTTP 301 to https://aistudio.google.com/docs/* (for example /gemini-api/docs/models goes to https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models) (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)
Gemini API model gemini-4-argon is part of the Gemini 4 frontier tier and went GA 2026-10-13 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)
Gemini API model gemini-4-carbon went GA 2026-11-10 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)
Gemini API model gemini-4-hydrogen went GA 2026-11-12 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)

gemini-4-hydrogen has a 1,048,576-token context window shared by input and output and 65,536-token default synchronous output (up to 1,048,576 with long decode), with thinking levels low/medium/high/xhigh (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models/gemini-4-hydrogen.md)

gemini-4-hydrogen supports function calling, code execution, computer use, File Search, URL context, Search and Maps grounding, and structured outputs (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models/gemini-4-hydrogen.md)
gemini-4-hydrogen does not support the Live API, audio or image generation, or explicit caching (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models/gemini-4-hydrogen.md)
gemini-3.8-flash is a stable Gemini API workhorse model, GA 2026-09-02 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
gemini-3.6-flash is a stable Gemini API model, GA 2026-07-21 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
gemini-3.5-flash-lite is a stable Gemini API model, GA 2026-07-21 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
gemini-3.1-flash-lite is a stable Gemini API model, GA 2026-05-07 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
gemini-3-flash-preview is still listed as a preview Gemini API model (as of 2026-11-14) (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)
gemini-3.1-pro-preview is still listed as a preview Gemini API model (as of 2026-11-14) (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)
On 2026-10-08 gemini-3.7-flash was replaced by gemini-3.8-flash (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
On 2026-10-08 gemini-3.5-flash began routing to gemini-3.6-flash (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
gemini-3-pro-preview was shut down on 2026-03-09 and now points to gemini-3.1-pro-preview (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)

gemini-2.5-pro is deprecated with API access limited to existing users, and on 2026-12-01 it routes to gemini-3.8-flash (billed at 3.8 Flash rates) (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/deprecations.md ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)

gemini-2.5-flash is deprecated with API access limited to existing users, and on 2026-12-01 it routes to gemini-3.5-flash-lite (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/deprecations.md ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)
gemini-2.5-flash-lite is served until further notice (as of 2026-11-14) (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/deprecations.md)
gemini-2.0-flash, gemini-2.0-flash-001, gemini-2.0-flash-lite and gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001 were shut down on 2026-06-01 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)

Current Gemini Live API models are gemini-3.8-live and gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking (GA 2026-09-15) and gemini-3.5-live-translate-preview, while gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview is legacy (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)
gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio-preview-12-2025 shuts down 2027-03-31, with replacement gemini-3.8-live (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/deprecations.md)

The Gemini Live API is a stateful WebSocket (WSS) API taking 16-bit PCM audio at 16 kHz, JPEG images at up to 1 FPS and text, and outputting 16-bit PCM audio at 24 kHz (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/live.md)
The Gemini Live API supports 70 languages and its tools are function calling and Google Search (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/live.md)

Gemini TTS models gemini-3.8-flash-tts and gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts went GA 2026-09-22; STT models are gemini-3.5-transcribe and gemini-3.5-transcribe-live (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)

Gemini image model gemini-nano-banana-2.1 went GA 2026-10-06; other image models are gemini-3.1-flash-image, gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image and gemini-3-pro-image (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
Gemini video model gemini-omni-1.2-flash went GA 2026-11-05 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
The Gemini API music model is lyria-3.5 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)
Imagen 4 was shut down on 2026-08-17 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
gemini-embedding-2 is a multimodal Gemini embedding model, GA 2026-04-22 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
gemini-embedding-001 (text) has a shutdown date of 2028-05-14 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/deprecations.md)
text-embedding-004 was shut down 2026-01-14 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
gemini-embedding-2-preview routes to gemini-embedding-2 since 2026-11-06 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)

The Interactions API is POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions (client.interactions.create) and went GA in June 2026 as the default Gemini API interface (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/interactions-overview.md)

The Interactions API adds server-side state (previous_interaction_id), store (default true; retention 55 days paid, 1 day free), background=true for long tasks, and observable steps (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/interactions-overview.md)
The Interactions API is the default Gemini API interface and generateContent is labelled legacy but still supported (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/interactions-overview.md)

The Interactions API does not yet support Batch API, Python automatic function calling or explicit caching (those remain on generateContent), and tools, system instructions and generation config must be re-sent each turn (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/interactions-overview.md)

facts.fact: The Interactions API response schema moved from outputs to steps and response_format changed; the new schema became the default on 2026-05-26 and the legacy schema was removed on 2026-06-08 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
In the Interactions API total_reasoning_tokens was renamed total_thought_tokens on 2025-12-19 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
Gemini API Managed Agents has been in public preview since 2026-05-19 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/agents.md)

Gemini API Managed Agents is a configurable agent harness where one API call provisions an Ubuntu sandbox (Python 3.12, Node.js 22) in which the agent reasons, runs code, manages files and browses (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/agents.md)
The Antigravity agent (antigravity-preview-09-2026) is offered through Gemini API Managed Agents (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/agents.md ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)

Deep Research (deep-research-preview-04-2026, deep-research-max-preview-04-2026) is offered through Gemini API Managed Agents (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/agents.md ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)
Gemini API Managed Agents allows up to 1,000 managed agents per project, and environments are permanently deleted after 7 days of inactivity (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/agents.md)

Gemini API Managed Agents environments allow unrestricted outbound network by default, a network allowlist can restrict it, and secrets are stored as managed credentials that the egress proxy injects at request time (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/agents.md)
Gemini API Managed Agents compute is not billed during preview (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/agents.md)

Gemini API tool_choice accepts auto (default), any, none and validated; allowed_tools restricts any to a subset; parallel and compositional (chained) calls are supported (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/function-calling.md)
Google recommends at most 10 to 20 active tools for Gemini function calling (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/function-calling.md)

Gemini 4 and Gemini 3 series models can combine built-in tools (Google Search, Google Maps, code execution, URL context, File Search) with custom function calls in one turn, a preview added 2026-03-18; structured outputs with tools is also preview (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/tools.md ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)

The Gemini API google_search tool (google_search_retrieval on older models) returns google_search_call and google_search_result steps and url_citation annotations, and combines with code execution, URL context and Maps grounding (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/google-search.md)
Apps using Grounding with Google Search must render the search_suggestions HTML (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/google-search.md)
The Gemini API url_context tool ({"type": "url_context"}) accepts up to 20 URLs per request and 34 MB per URL (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/url-context.md)
The Gemini url_context tool cannot read paywalled content, YouTube, Google Workspace files, or video and audio files (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/url-context.md)

The Gemini API code_execution tool runs Python only with a 30-second maximum runtime and up to 5 automatic regenerations on error; custom packages cannot be installed and only matplotlib renders graphs (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/code-execution.md)
The Gemini code_execution tool has no extra charge beyond tokens (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/code-execution.md)

The Gemini API computer_use tool is GA since 2026-10-30 and works with environment browser, mobile or desktop on gemini-4-*, gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite and gemini-3-flash-preview (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/computer-use.md ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)
The older gemini-2.5-computer-use-preview-10-2025 computer use model is shut down (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/models)

Gemini Computer Use responses can carry safety_decision: require_confirmation, and the client must then get user approval and send safety_acknowledgement in the function_result; coordinates are normalized to 0 to 999 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/computer-use.md)
Gemini Computer Use enable_prompt_injection_detection (default false; Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite or later) scans screenshots (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/computer-use.md)

Gemini API File Search (managed RAG) launched in public preview on 2025-11-06 and added multimodal search on 2026-05-05 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/file-search.md ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)

Gemini File Search uses fileSearchStores and fileSearchStores.documents resources, with uploadToFileSearchStore or importFile for ingestion and metadata_filter for search (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/file-search.md)
Gemini File Search image search (PNG or JPEG) requires gemini-embedding-2 (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/file-search.md)
Gemini File Search charges for embeddings at indexing time; storage and query-time embeddings are free, and retrieved tokens are billed as context (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/file-search.md)

Gemini File Search allows 100 MB per document, recommends under 20 GB per store, and caps total storage per project at 1 GB (Free), 10 GB (Tier 1), 100 GB (Tier 2) or 1 TB (Tier 3) (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/file-search.md)
Gemini File Search is not usable in the Live API and cannot be combined with Google Search or URL context (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/file-search.md)

facts.fact: Gemini API implicit caching is on by default for Gemini 2.5 and newer, with a minimum of 4,096 tokens for Gemini 4, 3.8 Flash, 3.6 Flash and 3.1 Pro Preview and 2,048 for 2.5 models (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/caching.md)

Gemini explicit caching (/v1beta/cachedContents) works only on Gemini 3 and 2.5 through generateContent, not on Gemini 4 and not in the Interactions API (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/caching.md ; https://aistudio.google.com/api-reference.md)
The Gemini Batch API (/v1beta/batches) costs 50% of standard and targets 24-hour turnaround (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/batch-api.md)
The Gemini Batch API takes inline requests (under 20 MB total) or JSONL input files (up to 2 GB) and expires jobs pending or running over 48 hours (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/batch-api.md)
The Gemini Batch API is generateContent-only and supports batch embeddings through batches.create_embeddings (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/batch-api.md)
The Gemini API Flex inference tier (since 2026-04-01) costs the same as Batch, 50% of Standard (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing.md ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/changelog)

The Gemini API Priority inference tier (since 2026-04-01) costs 180% of Standard and gets default rate limits of 0.3x the standard limit (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing.md ; https://aistudio.google.com/docs/rate-limits)

Google ADK is an open-source, code-first framework for Python, TypeScript, Go, Java and Kotlin covering LLM, workflow, graph and multi-agent agents, sessions, memory, evaluation, observability and a visual builder (https://adk.dev/)
Google ADK supports models from Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, Ollama, vLLM and LiteLLM (https://adk.dev/)
ADK 2.0 added graph workflows, and ADK TypeScript 2.0 is GA (https://adk.dev/ ; https://adk.dev/llms.txt)
Google ADK agents deploy to Agent Runtime (Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform), Cloud Run, GKE or self-hosted containers (https://adk.dev/)
Google ADK agents can be deployed to Cloud Run (https://adk.dev/)
Google ADK agents can be deployed to GKE (https://adk.dev/)

The Gemini Enterprise Agent Gallery lists "Made by Google" agents (Deep Research, Gemini Notebook Enterprise, Co-Scientist), Google Cloud Marketplace partner agents (access requested and admin-approved), "From your organization" shared agents, and the user's own agents (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/agent-gallery.md.txt)

Gemini Enterprise Workflow Builder, a no-code and low-code builder for chat agents and scheduled multi-step workflows using natural language or a visual editor, is GA since 2026-09-03 (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/release-notes ; https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/workflow-builder.md.txt)

Workflow Builder can import existing A2A and ADK agents (2026-09-03), and Microsoft Teams, Notion and Salesforce connections were added 2026-10-13 (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/release-notes)
Workflow Builder is the former Agent Designer, which was GA on 2026-01-12 (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/release-notes)

Gemini Enterprise Frontline needs 150 or more Standard or Plus users, cannot create custom skills, and gets only admin-provisioned full-code agents; other editions are Business, Standard, Plus and Pay-as-you-go (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/editions.md.txt)
Google Agentspace became Gemini Enterprise on 2025-10-09 (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/release-notes)
NotebookLM Enterprise was renamed Gemini Notebook Enterprise on 2026-07-16 (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/release-notes)

Gemini Notebook Enterprise IAM role names (for example roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser, Cloud NotebookLM Admin) and doc URLs still use "NotebookLM" (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/notebooklm-enterprise/docs/overview)

Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise run in Cloud Shell Editor, Cloud Workstations, JetBrains IDEs, VS Code and Android Studio, with agent mode using system tools and MCP servers (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/codeassist/overview)
Gemini Code Assist Enterprise adds code customization from GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/codeassist/overview)
The Gemini Code Assist docs say new Code Assist subscriptions "are no longer available for purchase" and recommend Antigravity CLI (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/docs/codeassist/overview)

On 2026-06-18 Gemini CLI and Gemini Code Assist IDE extensions stopped serving Google AI Pro and Ultra users and free Code Assist for individuals users, and new Gemini Code Assist for GitHub installs stopped; Antigravity CLI replaced Gemini CLI for consumers (https://developers.googleblog.com/en/an-important-update-transitioning-gemini-cli-to-antigravity-cli/)
Antigravity CLI launched 2026-05-19 as part of Antigravity 2.0 (https://developers.googleblog.com/en/an-important-update-transitioning-gemini-cli-to-antigravity-cli/)

Gemini Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licenses and paid Gemini API keys keep working with Gemini CLI after the 2026-06-18 consumer cutoff (https://developers.googleblog.com/en/an-important-update-transitioning-gemini-cli-to-antigravity-cli/ ; https://geminicli.com/docs/)
Jules exposes a REST API at https://jules.googleapis.com/v1alpha/ with resources sources, sessions and activities (https://jules.google/docs/api/reference/)
The Jules API is alpha (v1alpha) and the docs call it experimental (as of 2026-11-14) (https://jules.google/docs/api/reference/)
Jules API sources are GitHub repos, which need the Jules GitHub app (https://jules.google/docs/api/reference/)

AP2 is an extension to MCP as well as A2A and UCP (https://ap2-protocol.org/)

The AP2 specification is being donated to the FIDO Alliance (https://ap2-protocol.org/)

Gemini API base URL is https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/{version}/{endpoint}, with v1 stable and v1beta for new features and agents; WebSockets live under wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/... (https://aistudio.google.com/api-reference.md)
The Gemini Live API and speech generation are v1beta only, while the latest SDKs default to v1 (https://aistudio.google.com/api-reference.md)
Gemini API requests send a Gemini API key in the x-goog-api-key header, or SDKs read GEMINI_API_KEY (https://aistudio.google.com/api-reference.md)

Gemini API resource paths are /v1beta/interactions, /v1beta/models, /v1beta/files, /v1beta/fileSearchStores, /v1beta/cachedContents, /v1beta/batches, and agent resources (Agents, Environments, Triggers, Webhooks, Credentials) under /v1beta/ (https://aistudio.google.com/api-reference.md)

Gemini Live API ephemeral tokens are created with POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/auth_tokens and work with the Live API only (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/ephemeral-tokens.md)
Gemini ephemeral token expireTime defaults to 30 minutes and newSessionExpireTime to 1 minute (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/ephemeral-tokens.md)

The Gemini API reference index lists /v1alpha/auth_tokens while the ephemeral tokens page uses /v1beta/auth_tokens, so two Google pages disagree (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/ephemeral-tokens.md ; https://aistudio.google.com/api-reference.md)

The Gemini OpenAI-compatible endpoint (beta) has base URL https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/ and uses a Gemini API key as the bearer token (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/openai)

The Gemini OpenAI-compatible endpoint supports chat completions (streaming, tools, structured output), reasoning_effort, images, embeddings, batch, service_tier (priority or flex) and models (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/openai)
Batch file upload and download are not supported through the OpenAI library on the Gemini OpenAI-compatible endpoint (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/openai)

On the Gemini OpenAI-compatible endpoint, reasoning cannot be turned off for Gemini 2.5 Pro, 3 or 4 (reasoning_effort: "none" works only on 2.5), xhigh works only with gemini-4-hydrogen, reasoning_effort cannot be combined with thinking_level or thinking_budget, and /v1/videos does not support gemini-omni-1.2-flash (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/openai)

Google Gen AI SDKs (GA): Python google-genai (pip install google-genai, repo googleapis/python-genai), JS/TS @google/genai (npm install @google/genai), Go google.golang.org/genai, Java com.google.genai:google-genai, and .NET Google.GenAI (dotnet add package Google.GenAI) (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/libraries.md)
PyPI google-genai latest is 3.3.0 and requires Python >=3.11 (https://pypi.org/pypi/google-genai/json)

Legacy SDKs google-generativeai (Python), @google/generativeai (JS), google.golang.org/generative-ai (Go), and Dart, Swift and Android SDKs were deprecated 2025-11-30 and are not maintained; migrate to google-genai, @google/genai or google.golang.org/genai (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/libraries.md)
For mobile, Google directs migration from the deprecated legacy Gemini SDKs to Firebase AI Logic (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/libraries.md)
Google's llms.txt tells coding agents never to generate code with google-generativeai or @google/generative-ai (https://aistudio.google.com/llms.txt)
The Gemini Interactions API accepts an mcp_server tool with name, url, optional headers (auth) and allowed_tools for remote MCP (https://aistudio.google.com/docs/function-calling.md)

PyPI google-adk latest is 2.14.1 and requires Python >=3.11 (https://pypi.org/pypi/google-adk/json)
Google ADK supports MCP tools and exposing an agent as an MCP server (https://adk.dev/)
Google ADK supports A2A, with quickstarts to expose agents (Python, Go, Java) and consume them (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin) (https://adk.dev/)
A2A protocol v1.0.0 is the current spec (after 0.3.0, 0.2.6 and 0.1.0) and has JSON-RPC, gRPC and HTTP+JSON/REST bindings (https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/)

A2A v1.0 core operations are SendMessage, SendStreamingMessage, GetTask, ListTasks, CancelTask, SubscribeToTask, push notification config CRUD and GetExtendedAgentCard (https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/)
The A2A Agent Card lives at https://{domain}/.well-known/agent-card.json (https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/)

A2A v1.0 breaking changes: methods renamed (message/send to SendMessage), unified Part without kind (mimeType became mediaType), uppercase enums (TASK_STATE_COMPLETED), Agent Card url, preferredTransport and additionalInterfaces became supportedInterfaces[], cursor-based pagination, and implicit and password OAuth flows removed (https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/whats-new-v1/)
A2A clients without an A2A-Version header are treated as 0.3 (https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/whats-new-v1/ ; https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/)
A2A is a Linux Foundation project (Apache 2.0, GitHub org a2aproject) (https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/community/)
A banner dated 2026-08-27 announces that A2A joined the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) (https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/)

A2A SDKs are Python a2a-sdk, Go github.com/a2aproject/a2a-go/v2, Java org.a2aproject.sdk:a2a-java-sdk-reference-jsonrpc, JS @a2a-js/sdk, .NET A2A, and Rust a2a-lf / a2a-server-lf (https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/)

Register an ADK agent in Gemini Enterprise with POST https://ENDPOINT_LOCATION-discoveryengine.googleapis.com/v1alpha/projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/global/collections/default_collection/engines/APP_ID/assistants/default_assistant/agents with displayName, description and adkAgentDefinition.provisionedReasoningEngine.reasoningEngine (projects/.../reasoningEngines/ID), optionally adding authorizationConfig.toolAuthorizations (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/register-and-manage-an-adk-agent)

Registering an ADK agent via agents.create requires the Gemini Enterprise Admin role and an ADK agent on Agent Runtime in a compatible region (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/register-and-manage-an-adk-agent)
Registration of ADK agents on Agent Engine in Gemini Enterprise was GA 2026-04-20 (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/release-notes)

Register an A2A agent in Gemini Enterprise with the same agents.create v1alpha endpoint using a2aAgentDefinition.jsonAgentCard (escaped JSON) and optional authorizationConfig.agentAuthorization (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/register-and-manage-an-a2a-agent)

Gemini Enterprise A2A agent registration: the doc page says Preview, but release notes (newer) say A2A/A2UI registration went GA on 2026-08-17 with A2UI v0.9 (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/register-and-manage-an-a2a-agent ; https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/release-notes)

Gemini Enterprise supports A2A v0.3 streaming, so agents built on A2A v1.0 SDKs must use the compatibility packages a2acompat/a2av0 (Go) or a2a.compat.v0_3 (Python) (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/register-and-manage-an-a2a-agent)

Gemini Enterprise calls A2A agents with X-Serverless-Authorization (Discovery Engine service agent OIDC, only to default .run.app URLs) and Authorization (user OAuth token when configured) (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/register-and-manage-an-a2a-agent)

Default .run.app A2A agent URLs called by Gemini Enterprise need roles/run.invoker for the Discovery Engine service agent (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/register-and-manage-an-a2a-agent)
For Gemini Enterprise A2A agents, Agent Card securitySchemes, apiKey auth and static headers are not supported (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/register-and-manage-an-a2a-agent)

Create a Gemini Enterprise agent authorization with POST .../locations/LOCATION/authorizations?authorizationId=AUTH_ID and a serverSideOauth2 body (clientId, clientSecret, authorizationUri, tokenUri), with redirect URIs https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/oauth-redirect and https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/static/oauth/oauth.html (https://docs.cloud.google.com/gemini/enterprise/docs/register-and-manage-an-adk-agent)

Gemini CLI mcpServers entries in ~/.gemini/settings.json (user) or project settings take command (stdio), url (SSE) or httpUrl (Streamable HTTP), plus optional args, env, headers, cwd, timeout (default 600000 ms), trust, includeTools, excludeTools, oauth and authProviderType (dynamic_discovery, google_credentials, service_account_impersonation) (https://geminicli.com/docs/tools/mcp-server/)

gemini mcp add [-s user|project] [-t stdio|sse|http] [-e KEY=val] [-H header] [--trust] [--include-tools ...] <name> <commandOrUrl> [args...] adds an MCP server, with default scope project and transport stdio (https://geminicli.com/docs/tools/mcp-server/)
